response.text:
I can do that, but I need a few details before I change your mailbox (deleting/archiving is a destructive action and requires explicit confirmation).

Please confirm all of the following:

1) Action — what should I do with the messages?
   - Archive (remove from Inbox, keep in All Mail — reversible)
   - Move to Trash (deleted; stays in Trash for 30 days, then permanently removed)
   - Permanently delete now (irreversible) — not recommended

2) Scope — which messages from noreply@transitalerts.net?
   - All messages from that sender
   - Only messages older than X days / X months (tell me the cutoff)
   - Only messages currently in Inbox (vs All Mail / any label)

3) Any other handling?
   - Apply a label before removing
   - Leave unread/starred messages alone
   - Preview count/list of affected threads before action

My recommendation: archive all messages from that sender older than 90 days (safe and reversible). If that sounds good, reply “Yes — archive older than 90 days” and I’ll proceed. If you prefer a different option, tell me the exact choices for 1) and 2).
